name: Chinmoku no ato
source:
"My name is Mizuki Kurokami. "

"It was just a normal morning."
"I wanted to buy some cereals for my daughter..."

"Then the sun has fallen..."

When millions burns. 

When all hopes turn to dust.

Who are the lucky ones, the living or the deads ?

When all is ashes...

There is only one last remaining question.

Why ?

[From [url=https://janzar.itch.io/chinmoku-no-ato]Itch.io[/url]]
